LESSON: CHRISTIAN MORAL VALUES: PURITY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible Selected Teachings
Topic 2.1: Christian Moral Values: Purity

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Christian Moral Values: Purity. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how one can avoid being lured to same-sex relationships, 1. How can you live a morally upright life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify moral values that a young person should uphold
2. describe forbidden sexual practises outlined in the Bible

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: CHRISTIAN MORAL VALUES: PURITY
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 9
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Christian Moral Values: Purity helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: CHRISTIAN MORAL VALUES: PURITY
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Identify moral values that a young person should uphold

What this means
In this part you learn to identify moral values that a young person should uphold. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify moral values that a young person should uphold.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Christian Moral Values: Purity” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify moral values that a young person should uphold. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Describe forbidden sexual practises outlined in the Bible

What this means
In this part you learn to describe forbidden sexual practises outlined in the Bible. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe forbidden sexual practises outlined in the Bible.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Christian Moral Values: Purity in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe forbidden sexual practises outlined in the Bible. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Christian Moral Values: Purity is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Christian Moral Values: Purity” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify moral values that a young person should uphold)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Christian Moral Values: Purity in your own words. (skill: describe forbidden sexual practises outlined in the Bible)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Christian Moral Values: Purity to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify moral values that a young person should uphold.
3. Practise this skill: describe forbidden sexual practises outlined in the Bible.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Christian Moral Values: Purity from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Christian Moral Values: Purity: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 9 learner study Christian Moral Values: Purity?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how one can avoid being lured to same-sex relationships, 1. How can you live a morally upright life?
2. Why should you maintain sexual purity as a Christian youth?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Christian Moral Values: Purity means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify moral values that a young person should uphold.
5. Be able to: describe forbidden sexual practises outlined in the Bible.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
